unit.why: The rebbe recounts the miracle of the Maharshal's candle, says his grandfather the Maggid had the same miracle, and tells how a needed book was brought to him from Heaven, open at the right place.

stories.start_quote: שמעתי מחתנו הרב החסיד וכו׳ ר׳ אלחנן
stories.end_quote: בהמקום שהיה נצרך לי לעיין בו
stories.summary_en: As reported by his son-in-law, the rebbe cited the Maharshal's miracle of a small candle burning all night (from Kav ha-Yashar), said his grandfather the Maggid had the same miracle, and told how Heaven once brought him a needed book, open at the right place, while he studied alone.
